name: Cashflow Supervision
passiveDesc: ATK is increased by 16/20/24/28/32%. When current HP increases or decreases, Normal Attack DMG is increased by 16/20/24/28/32%, Charged Attack DMG is increased by 14/17.5/21/24.5/28%, and Stellar-Conduct DMG is increased by 14/17.5/21/24.5/28% for 4s. Max 3 stacks. This effect can be triggered once every 0.3s. When the wielder has 3 stacks, ATK SPD will be increased by 8/10/12/14/16%.

modifiers.label: Normal Attack DMG Bonus per HP-change stack
Charged Attack DMG Bonus per HP-change stack
Stellar-Conduct DMG Bonus per same HP-change stack
ATK SPD Bonus while 3 HP-change stacks are active
